description: This file contains implementation of converting a computational graph to SSA form in PyTorch JIT, including adding control flow loads/stores, handling loop continuations, and erasing load/store nodes.

classes.name: ControlFlowLoadStores
classes.description: Handles adding loads and stores to control flow nodes in the graph.

classes.name: EraseLoadStores
classes.description: Removes load and store nodes from the graph after control flow has been set.

classes.name: LoopContinuations
classes.description: Transforms break and continue statements into loop continuations for SSA conversion.

methods.name: addBlockInput
methods.description: Adds a store for a variable at the beginning of a block.

methods.name: addBlockOutput
methods.description: Adds a load for a variable at the end of a block.

methods.name: addNodeOutput
methods.description: Adds an output to a node and creates a store for it.

methods.name: addNodeInput
methods.description: Adds a load as input to a node.

methods.name: addIfLoadStores
methods.description: Adds loads and stores for if-else control flow nodes.

methods.name: addLoopLoadStores
methods.description: Adds loads and stores for loop control flow nodes.

methods.name: addControlFlowLoadStores
methods.description: Recursively adds control flow loads/stores within a block.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes control flow load/store addition on a graph.

methods.name: eraseBlockLoadStores
methods.description: Removes load/store nodes from a block.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes load/store erasure on a graph.

methods.name: addLoopCarriedOutputs
methods.description: Adds loop-carried variable outputs for break/continue transformation.

methods.name: assignExitContinuations
methods.description: Replaces break/continue with loop continuation nodes.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the loop continuation transformation on a graph.

methods.name: ConvertToSSA
methods.description: Main function to convert a graph to SSA form in PyTorch JIT.
